title: Relations between Equivalents
version: Chemical News 10, 59–60, 30 July 1864; Wellcome Library public-domain scan
lineage: Earlier contemporary evidence of numerical grouping and a predicted missing intermediate. These pages do not establish all properties of the proposed missing element.

passages.note: Printed pp. 59–60 / source PDF pp. 65–66: numerical ordering, chemical group relationships and an unfilled silicon–tin triad estimated as 73.

file.method: Selected pages extracted without changing page content using pdfseparate/pdfunite; corresponding raster renders checked against the complete source. Source-page numbering counts the original PDF from one.
